question: When every repeat adds one independently randomized legal geometry start to the fixed P0601 start, is the gamma=0 versus gamma=1 difference stable across optimizer basins?

locked_formula.geometry_family: same six P0601 pseudo-elliptical and shear parameters

robustness.repeat_definition: Each repeat contains the fixed P0601 start plus one seed-dependent random legal start; retain the lower training cost.
robustness.primary_comparison: best complete training fit for each gamma
robustness.distribution_comparison: median and 16-84 percentile training and spent-heldout RMS across repeats

claim_limits: This audit is post hoc after P0608 and after the deterministic-repeat issue in P0608B.
Each repeat compares one random start to the same fixed start, so the retained distribution is censored at the deterministic solution.
RX J2129 and every image split remain spent.
A stable gamma difference would still require transfer to a different cluster.
An unstable result demonstrates non-identifiability in this model; it does not prove single-plane gravity.
